CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, October 18, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE AUGUST 16, 2023 AND SEPTEMBER 20, 2023 REGULAR
  MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  September 20, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, September 20, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:01 P.M. on Wednesday, September 20, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Longoria.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano and Commission Member
Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 16, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
The minutes could not be approved at this time due to lack of attendance of Commissioners
present from the August 16, 2023 meeting.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission are continuing their location and type
of art research for their proposed Alhambra District Art projects; they will return with more
information to discuss at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared event details and invited the City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission to attend the upcoming Autumn Fest on Saturday October 7, 2023 and the 10th
annual Alhambra Pumpkin Run on Sunday October 29, 2023.

CSC HEALTH PROPOSAL
Architect Sean So from the CSC Health Regional Center presented a PowerPoint for a proposed
public water art feature at 726 East Main Street titled “Oceans of Alhambra”. Mr. So explained
the sculpture’s form is symbolic of the Asian culture of the community and has two curves
representing the interconnected forces of yin and yang, creating a tranquil cascade for visitors to
enjoy. The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission thanked Mr. So for his presentation and
provided their perspective with suggestions of researching the history of Alhambra and
incorporating a more dynamic artistic element to better distinguish itself as art instead of only a
water feature. President Canseco and Vice President Saunders offered assistance with research
materials and Alhambra’s history.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
 None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Saunders is interested in creating a physical and virtual city of Alhambra art
registry. Deputy Director Houghton agreed the art registry would be resourceful and will
research the process of creating an art registry for the city.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and second by Commission Member Longoria, the September
20, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 8:12 P.M.
